synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one.
synth.s1: The librarian asked us to keep quiet.
synth.s2: She was worried we would disturb others.
answers: that we would disturb others the librarian asked us to keep quiet
we would disturb others the librarian asked us to keep quiet
synth.answer: that we would disturb others the librarian asked us to keep quiet

synth.full: Concerned that we would disturb others, the librarian asked us to keep quiet.
